final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), all_region_average AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS figure FROM region_averages), above_average_regions AS (SELECT region, figure FROM region_averages WHERE figure > (SELECT figure FROM all_region_average)) SELECT region, figure, figure - (SELECT figure FROM all_region_average) AS amount_above_average, figure / (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM above_average_regions) AS ratio_to_above_average FROM above_average_regions
